articles.summary: Marks the Company’s 31st Consecutive Annual Dividend Increase Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. , (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: LECO) announced today that its Board of Directors approved a 10 percent increase in the quarterly cash dividend to $0.87 per share, or $3.48 per share of common stock on an annualized basis. The dividend is payable January 15, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 31, 2026. “Our annual dividend increase underscores our confidence in the execution of our RISE strategy, the Company’s strong cash generation, and how well-positioned we are for long-term growth,” said Steven B. Hedlund, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “Our dividend remains an important component of our capital allocation strategy and reflects our commitment to returning value to our shareholders.” Lincoln Electric has paid a cash dividend every quarter since going public in 1995 and has increased its dividend annually for 31 consecutive years.
